what: Project bootstrap (ADR 0009) end to end through Paperclip with real providers: Codex for stack, charter, blueprint and review, Claude for implementation. Prompt: a frontend-only React e-commerce prototype, at most five pages (landing, search, product detail, checkout, order confirmation), modern UI, maturity prototype.
path: bootstrap-e2e CLI (does what the wizard does through Paperclip's REST API) -> Paperclip task LOC-58 -> adapter -> bridge -> Temporal -> host worker; then the generated tasks LOC-60..67 ran through the normal pipeline

attempts.result: refused: the bootstrap form in the task was not valid JSON (Paperclip turns literal backslash-n sequences into newlines)
planning ok in about 3 minutes; scaffold refused: the worker has no ORCHESTRATOR_PROJECTS_ROOT
attempts.fix: the bridge passes the projects folder to the workflow

attempts.result: completed: private repository, verified scaffold, manifest, 8 issues; then two tasks of one milestone started in parallel and the last task listed five blockers
attempts.fix: plans are strictly sequential (each task has exactly one blocker)

attempts.result: completed: rambosoft/aurora-store (private), 9 issues (3 milestones, 6 tasks), all six tasks built and published as stacked draft PRs #1..#8
